scope: Setting0 training blocks2–6; ten complete slots; observed ROWS onset; only rows and recordings with full -100..2000ms coverage; no crossing target row end.
book_averaging: Equal available books within reader, then equal ten readers. sub-15 contributes GarnettDream only; this ten-reader extension differs from the balanced nine-reader main analysis.
baseline: 13 pre-row samples; quantize to original float16 cache precision before float32 baseline subtraction
numeric_reduction_note: Original summary used float32 joint reductions; extended sample-wise accumulation uses float64. Condition counts and published three-decimal group RMS are identical; max absolute reader-map difference must remain below 0.0001 µV.
